package gateways

import (
	"context"

	models "example.test/gwapp/internal/models/gateways"
	"example.test/gwapp/internal/scope"

	"github.com/plutoframework/pluto-core/pagination"
)

// History returns one page of the verified machine's own heartbeats.
func History(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	ports HistoryPorts,
	in models.HistoryRequest,
) (pagination.Page[models.BeatRow], error) {
	return ports.Registry.History(ctx, e, in)
}
